messages:
sam: Noticed a jump in decode errors for quant-v4b in ap-southeast during the 01:00 window. Canary error ~4.3%. Thinking we should apply a region-scoped runtime soft-pin while we investigate. :warning:

maya: Agreed region-only. Avoid global freeze if possible. Can we add a tenant-level bypass for critical traffic?

lisa: FYI SDK 2.7 has a KV cache marshaling mismatch that can manifest as decode failures under certain sequences. We have a compatibility shim in 2.8.2 (pending publish). If we pin runtime, block auto-unpin until we confirm SDK rollout.

zach: Oncall: correlating with increased p99 and GC churn on long-seq flows. Reroute to a lite variant for non-critical tenants is low impact. Runtime rollback is less risky than model rollback now.

sam: Proposed actions: 1) apply runtime soft-pin in ap-southeast for quantized model group; 2) split traffic: primary 80% quant-v4b, fallback 20% qn-v4b-lite; 3) prevent auto-unpin until SDK advisory and 2 successful canary cycles. Applying pin now.

deploybot: Automated: pin applied -> scope=runtime:v3.2, model_group=quantized, region=ap-southeast, id=pin-1797770000, started=2026-03-23T01:40Z. Auto-unpin disabled while advisory open.

maya: I updated the rollout doc and added the tenant bypass list and monitoring thresholds (decode_err_rate, gc_pauses, p99 latency).

oncall-bot: Alert: decode_error_rate 4.3% triggered in ap-southeast. Monitoring window extended to 30m.

lisa: SDK 2.8.2 published to pypi/npm with KV cache shim. Drafted advisory for release notes and support channels. Recommend sending a short note to key customers.

zach: Holding routing config for 50m. If error <1.5% for 20m across canary cycles we can re-evaluate unpin. If not, consider rollback or widen routing to 40% fallback.

eng-platform: Release notes entry added: "Regional runtime soft-pin applied in ap-southeast for runtime v3.2 affecting quantized models due to KV cache marshaling regression with SDK 2.7. Action: upgrade to SDK 2.8.2+. Temporary routing to qn-v4b-lite applied as mitigation."

sam: Leaving the pin in place until two healthy canary cycles post SDK adoption or until 04:00Z. To unpin manually run: `/pin remove pin-1797770000` (requires eng-releases approval). Will update thread with status. :white_check_mark:
